notes:
## Fixed

- Confirm that a minimized window is actually restored before treating activation as successful. Focus metadata alone can no longer report success while the window remains minimized.

## Changed

- Add integrated tests through the production taskbar, action executor and Accessibility reader for window actions, grouped windows, file-drag activation, Quit and persisted button order.
- Exercise the actual height-adjustment writer and restoration, startup, permission-loss handling and status-icon recovery. All nine deliberately disabled core behaviors now fail regression assertions.
- Report application-only code coverage in CI, excluding test-source coverage. Keep the new behavior scenarios in the constrained-executor checks.
- Include the approved light, layered native app icon. Release attachments now contain only the installable app archive.

## Verification

The complete XCTest suite, constrained-executor checks, WindowLab replays, workflow tests and arm64 Release build pass. No new permissions, dependencies or global input observers. Isolated tests do not replace acceptance on real third-party windows and physical monitors.
